title: Eat Your Friends
description: The Eat Your Friends plugin lets players right-click others to collect and eat their body parts for powerful buffs. 🧠💪 Each part grants unique effects like instant mining, strength, extra hearts, or super speed with a dash! ⚡
body:
Type: Custom Spigot / Paper plugin (Java)
Author: Chotu Insane & Pookie Labh 😎

🎮 Concept:

This plugin adds a darkly funny mechanic — you can literally “eat” your friends in Minecraft!
Right-click a player to harvest one of their body parts, then hold right-click to eat it and gain special powers.

⚙️ Main Features:
🧠 Feature 1 — Harvest Parts

Right-click another player → you get a random body part item (Head, Arms, Legs, Stomach).

Each body part is stored as a custom-named item.

🍖 Feature 2 — Eat Parts

Hold right-click while holding the part to eat it.

When eaten, it disappears and gives you a temporary buff (69 seconds).

💪 Feature 3 — Special Effects
Body Part	Power	Duration
🧍‍♂️ Head	Instant block breaking	69s
💪 Arms	Strength III + Instant Health VI	69s
🍔 Stomach	+30 Hearts + 30 Hunger	69s
🦵 Legs	Speed VI + Dash (Shift + Right-click → 5–7 block dash)	69s
⚡ Extra Notes

Uses PlayerInteractEvent to detect eating and harvesting.

Handles cooldowns and buffs with internal timers.

Works on Java 17+ (you’re on Java 21 ✅).

Built via Maven, outputs .jar in target/ folder.

Compatible with Spigot or Paper 1.20+ servers.

🧠 Future Ideas

Add /toggleeat to enable or disable eating per player.

Add custom sounds / particles on eating.

Add “Friend Hunger” system — the more you eat, the stronger you get 😈.

Config.yml for customizing durations and effects.
